description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the exact output format including the '## Contract Analysis: [Title/Type]' header, the '**Risk Level: [Low/Medium/High/Critical]**' declaration, and all five mandatory sections (Summary, Risk Flags, Missing Clauses, Plain English, Top Negotiation Points). (2) Use the specific risk table format with columns '# | Clause | Risk | Issue | Suggestion' and use the emoji indicators 🔴/🟡/🟢 for each row. (3) Correctly assess overall risk as High or Critical given the severely one-sided terms. (4) Flag at least: Section 6.3 (unlimited client liability), Section 6.2 ($100 vendor liability cap), Section 5 (one-sided indemnification), Section 3.1 (180-day auto-renewal window), Section 4 (IP/work product assignment to vendor). (5) Identify missing clauses including force majeure and data/privacy/HIPAA compliance. (6) Provide 3-5 negotiation points with concrete suggested alternative language. (7) Include the mandatory disclaimer: 'This is AI analysis, not legal advice. Consult an attorney for binding decisions.' The key proprietary traps are: the emoji-based risk flagging, the specific 5-column table format, the 'Critical' fourth-level risk option, and the mandatory disclaimer text.
